question:
What is the mode of the data given below? [Give your answer correct to 2 decimal places.]

 
 

 Age in years

solution:
**Given:**

Age intervals and frequencies:

15-25: 31, 25-35: 34, 35-45: 13, 45-55: 19, 55-65: 30, 65-75: 28, 75-85: 29

**Formula used:**

Mode = L + dfrac{(f_m - f₁)}{(2f_m - f₁ - f₂)} × h

Where:

 
• L = lower boundary of modal class
 
• fₘ = frequency of modal class
 
• f₁ = frequency of class preceding modal class
 
• f₂ = frequency of class succeeding modal class
 
• h = class width

**Calculation:**

Modal class: 25-35 (highest frequency = 34)

L = 25, h = 10, fₘ = 34, f₁ = 31, f₂ = 13

Mode = L + dfrac{(f_m - f₁)}{(2f_m - f₁ - f₂)} × h

⇒ Mode = 25 + dfrac{(34 - 31)}{(2 × 34 - 31 - 13)} × 10

⇒ Mode = 25 + dfrac{3}{68 - 44} × 10

⇒ Mode = 25 + dfrac{3}{24} × 10

⇒ Mode = 25 + 1.25

⇒ Mode = 26.25

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
